svg.text: Reichelt H25PR050 (solder dots, 2.54 mm grid) cut to 19 × 28 holes = 50 × 72 mm. Shaded strips top and bottom sit in the Delock 65989 holder: keep them free.
Parts on top; wires and bridges run underneath
Turned over left to right: what you see while soldering
GND: J1-2 → J3 → R2 → Q1 E
Base: R1 → Q1 B (bridge to the pad beside it)
Coil −: Q1 C → D1 anode → J2-2 (A2)
Where each part goes (column letter, row number)
3-pole screw terminal 5.08, openings to the top edge
J14 E, J15 B, J16 C
2-pole screw terminal 5.08, openings to the bottom edge
